root_cause.text: The igc driver incorrectly configured the TSN transmit packet buffer size to 7KB per queue instead of the hardware-recommended 5KB, causing TX unit hangs under heavy timestamping loads.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the `IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN` macro in `igc_defines.h` to reduce the buffer allocation from 7 to 5 units per queue, while the commit message explicitly states the previous 7KB setting "caused TX unit hangs under heavy timestamping load" and violates the I225/I226 SW User Manual recommendations.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN configuration values to comply with I225/I226 SW User Manual Section 7.5.4.
intent_record.what: Added a comment citing I225/I226 SW User Manual Section 7.5.4 and changed IGC_TXPBSIZE_TSN macro arguments from 7 to 5 for all four TX packet buffer sizes.
intent_record.how: Adjusts the TSN transmit packet buffer configuration registers to match the hardware specification, ensuring correct buffer allocation during time-sensitive network operations.
